sa19:1.2: One time, the Buddha was staying at Anāthapiṇḍada’s Park in Jeta’s Grove of Śrāvastī.
sa19:2.1: There was then a certain monk who rose from his seat. [He adjusted his robes to bare his right shoulder,] bowed to the Buddha, [and withdrew to stand at one side].
sa19:2.2: He then said to the Buddha,
sa19:2.3: “[It would be good,] Bhagavān, if you were to give me a brief explanation of the Dharma.
sa19:2.4: Having listened to the Dharma, I will go alone to a quiet place, focus on contemplation, and live earnestly.
sa19:2.5: Having lived earnestly, I’ll then think,
sa19:2.6: ‘A good son [leaves home, cuts off his hair and beard, puts on the Dharma robes,] is a believer in the homeless, and leaves home …
sa19:2.7: up to … He himself knows that he won’t be subject to a later existence.’”
sa19:3.1: The Bhagavān then told that monk,
sa19:3.3: ‘It would be good, Bhagavān, if you were to give me a brief explanation of the Dharma.
sa19:3.4: Having listened to the Dharma, I’ll go alone to a quiet place, focus on contemplation, and live earnestly … up to …
sa19:3.5: “He himself knows that he won’t be subject to a later existence.”’ [Is this what you said?]”
sa19:4.1: The monk said to the Buddha,
sa19:5.2: “Listen closely! Listen closely, and consider it well.
sa19:5.3: I will explain this for you.
sa19:5.4: Monk, one should quickly get rid of something that’s a tying bond.
sa19:5.5: Once one gets rid of that, they will be benefited by this doctrine, and they’ll find happiness for a long time.”
sa19:6.1: That monk then said to the Buddha,
sa19:7.1: The Buddha said to the monk,
sa19:7.2: “How do you understand the meaning of my brief explanation of the Dharma in full?”
sa19:8.1: The monk said to the Buddha,
sa19:8.2: “Bhagavān, form is something that’s a tying bond.
sa19:8.3: I should quickly get rid of something that’s a tying bond.
sa19:8.4: Having gotten rid of it, I will benefit by this doctrine, and I’ll find happiness for a long time.
sa19:8.5: Thus, feeling … conception … volition … awareness is something that’s a tying bond.
sa19:8.6: I should quickly get rid of something that’s a tying bond.
sa19:8.7: Having gotten rid of it, I will benefit by this doctrine, and I’ll find happiness for a long time.
sa19:8.8: Therefore, I understand the meaning of the Bhagavān’s brief explanation of the Dharma in full.”
sa19:9.2: “Good! It’s good, monk, that you understand the meaning of my brief explanation of the Dharma in full.
sa19:9.4: Form is something that’s a tying bond.
sa19:9.5: One should quickly get rid of something that’s a tying bond.
sa19:9.6: Having gotten rid of it, they will benefit by this doctrine, and they’ll find happiness for a long time.
sa19:9.7: Feeling … conception … volition … awareness is something that’s a tying bond.
sa19:9.8: One should quickly get rid of something that’s a tying bond.
sa19:9.9: Having gotten rid of it, they will benefit from this doctrine, and they’ll find happiness for a long time.”
sa19:10.1: When that monk heard what the Buddha taught, he felt great joy.
sa19:10.2: He then bowed to the Buddha and withdrew.
sa19:10.3: He went alone to a quiet place where he diligently trained and lived earnestly … up to …
sa19:10.4: [That monk’s] mind was liberated, and he became an arhat.
